description: Workout Presets & Progressive Overload: day-based preset library with a searchable exercise catalog, preset-driven routine execution (sets, reps, RPE, completion, auto rest timer, haptics, screen-awake), weight analytics (Vico trend charts, Epley 1-RM), and alternative-exercise weight conversion from historical 1RM ratios; replaces the v2 manual set-matrix flow; adds schema 16 to 17.
